qualification: Deterministic Docker API, Ollama HTTP and OpenShell fixtures with the real Rust provider and OpenTofu; no live containers or model downloads.
contracts: Initial apply, unchanged apply and export/reapply preserve identities with one initial model pull.
Legacy service/model state gains independent storage binding on apply without recreating the container or pulling models; destroy refuses before this upgrade.
Stopped-service plan makes no runtime mutation and explicitly defers model inventory and the complete deployment plan.
Failed startup retains container and volume identities; explicit recovery starts the same container without another model pull.
API startup polls only connection refusal with the existing 30-second budget; authentication, transport and incomplete inventory fail.
Ordinary failed model inventory stops plan/apply/export without changing Terraform state.
Engine observation failure and replaced volume identity stop destroy before any container deletion.
Destroy retains tracked model storage, releases model installation bindings without model API calls, and deletes only the verified container.
Lost successful delete response is reconciled by explicit destroy after confirmed container absence, without another deletion.
Reapply after destroy creates a new container on unchanged retained storage and reuses the existing model without another pull.
observationBoundaries: Existing Ollama observations remain direct Docker/Ollama API reads shared by provider and export. New retained storage observation uses the same Docker adapter. OpenShell osquery-backed refresh/export is unchanged. Startup readiness is an active direct probe.
limits: No new live Ollama hardware qualification or native agent response in this slice.
Image/network changes remain subject to existing immutable configuration checks; retained storage keeps legacy specification labels.
Plan while Ollama is stopped is explicitly incomplete until service recovery permits full fresh inventory.
